notes.title: INVESTMENT HERO - UPDATE I
notes.content:
[i]This is the first INVESTMENT-HERO-Early-Access-Version Patch and it will bring you several gameplay improving, helpful and supportive features.[/i]

[b]TUTORIAL[/b]
A [i]Tutorial-Menu[/i] will be added to the game. Accessable from within the game as well as from the main menu. The intend is to teach players, who are new to the game the basics of the way to play as well as some strategic tips, in case you don't want to figure out everything yourself.

[b]SCOREBOARD[/b]
A [i]Scoreboard[/i] is being added to the game, so you can take a look at your best attempts, according the different difficulties.

[b]MORE LANGUAGES[/b]
Translations into [i]German[/i], [i]French[/i] and [i]Spanish[/i] will be added to the game. Your preference can be changed via the Settings menu and will be auto-saved for all future sessions. Default language will still be [i]English[/i].

[b]FLOW-IMPROVING-FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Economy-Graph[/i]: A graph will be added to the upper taskbar of the game, where the current economy is being indicated. This will enable the player the better overview over both the current situation as well as the past and future development.
[*] [i]Camera-Focussing[/i]: When you select one of your buildings - no matter which way you do it - the 3D camera will now move to also show you the building in 3D space.
[*] [i]Taskbar-Playermenu-Connection[/i]: You will now be able to select any entry in the foldable lists from the upper Taskbar, and the game will link you to the according and more detailed entry inside the Playermenu.
[/list]

[b]MORE MUSIC[/b]
The music track from the INVESTMENT-HERO-Reveal-Trailer will be added to the in-game-playlist.

[b]BUG-FIXES[/b]
Since the game released as an Early-Access-Build just today, I will try observe as many issues of any kind, you might encounter to make sure the gameplay-experience is as fluid and immersive as possible. Any reviews, questions and critiques are highly appreciated!

[i]Because the update will patch most of the bigger gaps of this EA-Build, so we can soon get to the finished-game-release, it will take me some time, but I wanted to make sure, everyone knows, what's to come. [b]The update will enroll February, 12th 2020.[/b][/i]
